contents_summary: One-page table: ECD, CV, HEX and CCT for the right and left eye of case 1 before surgery and at 3 months, and of case 2 before surgery with the 3 month column marked NA (lost to follow-up). 24 numeric cells and 4 variable-level NA cells.

pages.contents:
Supplementary Table 1. ECD, CV, HEX, and CCT values of both eyes before and 3 months after surgery
Variable | Case 1 Before surgery | Case 1 3 mon | Case 2 Before surgery | Case 2 3 mon*
ECD (cells/mm²) | | | | NA
Right eye | 3,021 | 2,762 | 2,740 |
Left eye | 3,003 | 3,012 | 2,770 |
CV | | | | NA
Right eye | 28 | 31 | 32 |
Left eye | 29 | 27 | 31 |
HEX (%) | | | | NA
Right eye | 52 | 45 | 50 |
Left eye | 50 | 48 | 50 |
CCT (µm) | | | | NA
Right eye | 524 | 531 | 544 |
Left eye | 529 | 533 | 549 |
ECD = endothelial cell density; CV = coefficient of variation of cell size; HEX = percentage of hexagonality; CCT = central corneal thickness by corneal topography; NA = not available.
*Lost to follow-up.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: One table of per-eye endothelial and corneal thickness measurements for case 1 (before surgery and 3 months) and case 2 (before surgery; 3 months marked NA, lost to follow-up). Columns are labelled Case 1 and Case 2, which map to p1 and p2. The case 2 3 mon column has only variable-level NA cells, which are not results.
limitations: No printed rights exception on the page; the article license applies to the asset as a source-license assumption.
The page has no calendar dates; the only time labels are Before surgery and 3 mon.
